summary: Backcountry skier swept an estimated 300-500 feet and buried neck-deep in an avalanche at the E Ticket couloir near Nellie Mine in the Bear Creek area; deployed an airbag and was dug out by companions within minutes, uninjured. Telluride Ski Patrol notified the sheriff's dispatch of a possible double burial; only one skier was caught.
location: Bear Creek area, E Ticket couloir near Nellie Mine, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office (notified by Telluride Ski Patrol); companion rescue
notes: Run 19 (San Miguel County SO news alerts). Release dated 2017-03-01. 26-year-old experienced backcountry skier; party of four left from the backcountry gate above Revelation Bowl, all carried beacons/probes/shovels/airbags. Self-rescue before SAR arrival — recorded per the sheriff's public release. Content read from search crawl of the alert page (browser.open unavailable this run).
